about: Places in Mumbai (Mumbai City or Mumbai Suburban) that GeoNames gives no district. Used by the "Which clock?" rule (D-082, D-086, D-087): a place counts as Mumbai if its district is IN.16.519 or IN.16.518, or its GeoNames id is listed here. Found in step 0.2.11 by checking every Indian populated place inside `area` (a rough outline of Mumbai City + Mumbai Suburban). The outline is checked by tests: it holds every place GeoNames codes as Mumbai (except Kandivli 1268126, whose GeoNames coordinates are wrong) and no place coded as another district.
